source: Harsho Group website (www.harshotz.com) and the Harsho Chicks poster, November 2026. Store map pins are town-level; confirm the exact spots.

stores.name: Harsho Chicks - Moshi Hatchery
stores.pickup_instructions: Chicks are hatched every Friday. Book at least one week ahead (minimum 50 chicks) and collect on your hatch day, or ask Harsho to deliver to your farm.
stores.bio: Harsho's hatchery in Moshi: Ross 308 day-old broiler chicks from Harsho's own breeder flock, vaccinated against Marek's and Newcastle, hatched every Friday. Minimum order 50 chicks; farm delivery can be arranged.
stores.bio_sw: Kituo cha kutotolesha cha Harsho, Moshi: vifaranga vya kuku wa nyama Ross 308 kutoka kundi la wazazi la Harsho, wamechanjwa Marek's na Newcastle, wanatotolewa kila Ijumaa. Oda ya chini vifaranga 50; usafirishaji hadi shambani unapangwa.

stores.name: Harsho - Dodoma (Kisasa)
stores.pickup_instructions: Book Harsho chicks at least one week ahead (minimum 50 chicks) and collect them here on the agreed day.
stores.bio: Harsho's Dodoma branch at Kisasa on the Dodoma-Morogoro road, for booking and collecting Harsho Ross 308 day-old broiler chicks.
stores.bio_sw: Tawi la Harsho Dodoma, Kisasa barabara ya Dodoma-Morogoro: kuweka oda na kuchukua vifaranga vya Harsho Ross 308.
